resources.string: Optional companion that receives destinations from your phone over Bluetooth LE or the local network and forwards them to CleanYourCar. It stays off until you enable a method, create a token and press Start.
Automatic startup now waits for setup. Tap to set up.

Since this update, the bridge no longer starts by itself and no longer accepts unauthenticated destinations. Enable BLE and/or LAN, create a pairing token, update your phone shortcut to send it, then press Start. Old shortcuts without a token are rejected.
Send this exact value as \"Authorization: Bearer <token>\" (HTTP) or as line 2 of a CYC-NAV/1 BLE message. Generating a new token revokes the old one.
No token. Generate one to pair your phone.
New token created. Update your phone shortcut, then press Start.
No local network address right now. Connect this unit to Wi-Fi or your phone\'s hotspot.

The token is not encryption: anyone on the same network can read plain HTTP traffic. Use LAN reception only on a network you trust, such as your own phone\'s hotspot. Addresses change between networks; check this screen instead of assuming a fixed address.
No runtime permission is needed on this Android version.
The bridge was not started. See the reasons on screen.
Setup incomplete: enable at least one method and create a token.
No pairing token. Generate one first.
Notification permission is missing; the bridge cannot show that it is running.
This device has no usable Bluetooth LE adapter.
This device cannot advertise as a BLE peripheral.
LAN reception is unavailable on this Android version: no permitted background service type covers it.
